note: As perguntas que se faz sobre cada fala de uma call de vendas. `label` é o que o integrante lê; `question`, `yes`, `no` e `means` são o que lê quem responde (a IA do integrante na revisão e no treino, o modelo de decisões no modo ao vivo). Quem responde só dá valores: toda conta é do script.

signals.label: Cliente mostrou interesse
signals.question: In this turn, does the client show they want to go ahead with what is being offered?
signals.yes: Asks how to begin, how the rollout or the contract works, asks to see or try it, or says it fits their case.
signals.no: Gives information, asks how one part works, raises a doubt, or makes small talk.

signals.label: Cliente se comprometeu
signals.question: In this turn, does the client say in plain words that they will buy, sign or start paying?
signals.yes: Agrees to the purchase, asks for the contract or the payment link, or accepts a paid trial.
signals.no: Shows interest only, accepts only another meeting, or still has a doubt.

signals.label: Cliente aceitou o próximo passo
signals.question: In this turn, does the client accept a specific next step with the seller?
signals.yes: Accepts a day and time, asks for the proposal to be sent for review, agrees to bring another person to the next talk, or accepts a trial.
signals.no: Asks only for material with no date, says they will think and call back, asks a question, or raises a doubt.

signals.label: Cliente levantou uma objeção
signals.question: In this turn, does the client hold back, doubt or push against buying?
signals.yes: Says it costs too much, that now is a bad time, that someone else has to approve, that they may not need it, that it may not work for them, or that they prefer another supplier.
signals.no: Asks a neutral question about what is included or how it works, describes their own situation, agrees, or makes small talk.

signals.label: Cliente concordou com o vendedor
signals.question: In this turn, does the client accept as reasonable what the seller has just said?
signals.yes: Says it makes sense, that the point is fair, or that it would work for them.
signals.no: Disagrees, brings a new doubt, asks a neutral question, or changes the subject.

signals.label: Cliente se afastando
signals.question: In this turn, does the client try to end the call early or put the seller off?
signals.yes: Asks for material by message instead of talking, says they have to leave, says they will think and come back with no date, says it is not a priority, or answers in single dismissive words.
signals.no: Asks real questions, describes their situation in detail, or accepts a next step.

signals.label: Cliente não entendeu
signals.question: In this turn, does the client show that they did not follow what the seller said?
signals.yes: Asks the seller to repeat or explain, asks what a word means, says they are lost, or asks something the seller's previous turn had already answered.
signals.no: Asks a clear question about something new, states something, or agrees.

signals.label: Cliente perguntou o preço
signals.question: In this turn, does the client ask what it costs, which plans exist or how it is charged?
signals.yes: Asks for the price, the plans, the payment terms or the charging model.
signals.no: Does not ask about price in this turn.

signals.label: Vendedor fez pergunta aberta
signals.question: Is this turn an open question from the seller that invites the client to describe their situation, how they work, what bothers them, what they want, or how they decide?
signals.yes: A question that cannot be answered with yes or no and is about the client's side.
signals.no: A yes or no question, a statement, a description of the offer, a price, or a proposal of a meeting.

signals.label: Vendedor despejando recursos
signals.question: In this turn, does the seller list what the offer does or its benefits without the client having asked, and end without a question to the client?
signals.yes: Describes resources, how it works or advantages on the seller's own initiative, with no question at the end.
signals.no: Answers something the client asked, asks the client a question, talks about the client's situation, states a price, or proposes a next step.

signals.label: Vendedor propôs o próximo passo
signals.question: In this turn, does the seller propose a specific next step?
signals.yes: Proposes a meeting with a day or time, sending the proposal, a trial, or bringing in another person from the client's side.
signals.no: Describes the offer, asks about the client's situation, or only says they will keep in touch.

signals.label: Outra opção na mesa
signals.question: Does this turn mention another supplier or another way of solving the problem that the client uses or is weighing instead of buying from the seller?
signals.yes: Names a competing company or service, says they are talking to others, or says they already pay someone else for this.
signals.no: Mentions only the seller's offer, the client's manual way of working, or tools that are part of the seller's offer.

facts.label: Cenário atual
facts.question: Up to this turn, has the client described how they work today: the process, the team, the tools or the channels?
facts.yes: The client has told how the work is done today, in their own words.
facts.no: Only greetings so far, or only the seller has talked about processes.

facts.label: Problema dito pelo cliente
facts.question: Up to this turn, has the client named a specific problem, waste or annoyance they live with today?
facts.yes: The client has said what does not work, what takes too long, what gets lost or what they pay for without return.
facts.no: Only the seller has talked about problems in general, or the client says all is well.

facts.label: Tamanho do problema
facts.question: Up to this turn, has the client said what the problem costs them: hours, money, sales or clients lost, or what it stops them from doing?
facts.yes: The client has given a quantity, a frequency or a consequence of the problem.
facts.no: The problem was only named, or only the seller talked about its cost.

facts.label: Valor de resolver
facts.question: Up to this turn, has the client said in their own words what would change or what it would be worth to have the problem solved?
facts.yes: The client has described the gain: time back, growth without hiring, a worry removed.
facts.no: Only the seller described benefits, or the client has not talked about the gain.

facts.label: Dinheiro na conversa
facts.question: Up to this turn, has money been talked about: the price of the offer, the client's budget, or what the client pays today?
facts.yes: The seller stated the price, or the client stated a budget, a range, a current cost, or whether money is set aside.
facts.no: Nobody has mentioned the price of the offer or the client's budget.

facts.label: Quem decide
facts.question: Up to this turn, has the client said who decides the purchase or how it gets approved?
facts.yes: The client said they decide alone, named a person or a role, or described the approval path.
facts.no: Nothing was said about who decides or approves.

facts.label: Prazo
facts.question: Up to this turn, has the client said when they want to decide, buy or have this working?
facts.yes: The client gave a date, a month, a season or said it is not for now.
facts.no: The client has given no timing for the decision or the start.

scores.label: Clima da conversa
scores.question: How is the tone between the two people in the recent turns? Judge the human tone, not whether the sale is going well.

levels.label: tenso
levels.means: Short answers, irritation, irony, or one talking over the other.

levels.label: neutro
levels.means: Polite and factual, with no personal remark or humor.

levels.label: próximo
levels.means: Humor or personal remarks, each one acknowledging the other, relaxed language.

scores.label: Participação do cliente
scores.question: How much is the client taking part, judging only by the client's recent turns?

levels.label: ausente
levels.means: One word or one line, deflects, or tries to end the call.

levels.label: responde
levels.means: Answers what is asked and adds nothing, with no question back.

levels.label: ativo
levels.means: Asks questions, gives detail about their situation, or brings ideas unprompted.

scores.label: Urgência do cliente
scores.question: How urgent is it for the client to solve the problem, judging only by the client's recent turns?

levels.label: sem pressa
levels.means: Exploring, curious, with no deadline or pressure.

levels.label: incomoda
levels.means: The problem hurts and goes on, and they want it fixed, with no deadline.

levels.label: urgente
levels.means: A deadline, a season, an order from above or a renewal is named, or they are losing clients or people now.

stages.label: Abertura
stages.means: Greetings, small talk, agreeing on the agenda. Nothing yet about the client's problem.
stages.not: Turns that describe the client's process or problems.

stages.label: Descoberta
stages.means: The seller asks about, or the client describes, how they work today, their problems, team or goals.
stages.not: Budget, who decides or deadlines, and talk about the offer itself.

stages.label: Qualificação
stages.means: Budget, who decides, how approval works, or when they want to decide or start.
stages.not: The problem itself, or what the offer does.

stages.label: Apresentação
stages.means: The seller explains or shows what the offer does and how it would work for this client.
stages.not: Turns where the client pushes back or asks the price.

stages.label: Objeções
stages.means: The client has raised a doubt or pushed back, and the seller is answering it.
stages.not: Neutral questions about how the offer works.

stages.label: Preço
stages.means: The price, the plans, discounts or contract terms of what is being sold.

stages.label: Fechamento
stages.means: The seller asks for the decision, or the client says yes to buying, signing or starting.
stages.not: Setting up a further meeting or a demonstration.

stages.label: Próximos passos
stages.means: Agreeing what happens after the call: another meeting, a trial, sending the proposal, bringing other people.

objection_kinds.label: preço
objection_kinds.means: It costs too much or the value is hard to justify.

objection_kinds.label: momento
objection_kinds.means: Now is a bad time: too busy, in the middle of something, come back later.

objection_kinds.label: decisão de outra pessoa
objection_kinds.means: The client cannot decide alone and someone else has to approve.

objection_kinds.label: necessidade
objection_kinds.means: The client doubts they have the problem, or thinks the present way is good enough.

objection_kinds.label: confiança
objection_kinds.means: Doubts about the seller, about it working for them, or about the risk and the work of changing.

objection_kinds.label: outra opção
objection_kinds.means: The client prefers, uses or is weighing another supplier instead.

objection_kinds.label: nenhuma
objection_kinds.means: The client has raised no doubt about buying.
